name: QWEN-ATTN-ATTRIB-1
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-ATTN-ATTRIB-1 (same session, registered before any recomposed artifact exists). Bars use static thresholds over derived scalars the observations builder computes from the frozen B/C receipts plus the three new arm receipts; floors are max over the arms compared. The dominance resolution rule (L-dominance iff bars 2-5 all fire; F-dominance iff bars 2 and 4 read below zero with 3 and 5 firing; else MIXED/UNRESOLVED) and the bracket-alarm stop are frozen in the prose entry.

F.description: B + C's S16 payload for full-attn q/k/v/o (64 tensors, +0.3905 GiB)

L.description: B + C's S16 payload for linear-attn in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/out_proj (144 tensors, +1.2888 GiB)

Q.description: A + C's S16 payload for linear-attn in_proj_qkv only (48 tensors, ~7.087 GiB total, iso-rate v B within 1.1%)

bars.name: SANITY-BRACKET-CLEAN
bars.description: zero of {X_F, X_L, K_F, K_L} outside [C_value - 5*floor, B_value + 5*floor]; a violation is a recomposer instrument alarm and the rung stops

bars.name: IO-WINS-ISO-K
bars.description: (K_Q - K_B) / f_K > 5: matched-budget io spend beats attention spend on K

bars.name: ATTN-WINS-ISO-K
bars.description: (K_B - K_Q) / f_K > 5: attention spend beats io on K at matched budget

refuted_if: Registered prior (i) — L carries more total recovery than F — is REFUTED if R_X(F) exceeds R_X(L) past the 5 f_X floor (bar 2 reads below zero while bar 3 fires); a gap inside the floor books UNADJUDICATED. A bar-1 bracket violation books INSTRUMENT-ALARM for the recomposer and no attribution claim exists.
registered_prior: House: (i) L carries more total recovery than F (medium; 3.3x bytes, 48 of 64 layers); (ii) F beats L per byte on U_X (weak); (iii) near-additive, both |I| < 0.2 (weak/medium); (iv) iso-rate: IO-WINS-ISO-K fires (medium, io's measured 2.2x per-byte K efficiency), X side tie-within-floors or io (weak).
